warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1)ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Net contents sits under the signature at the foot of the front and is letterspaced, '750mL'; the gap between '0' and 'm' matches the gap between the digits, so no word space is visible.
Alcohol reads '40% ALC./VOL.' with '80 PROOF' on the line below.
The warning has no space after '(1)': it prints '(1)ACCORDING'. The '(2)' later in the same paragraph does have its space.
